en.name: One-leg balance
en.subtitle: Experimental shape checks
steps: Stand on one leg and lift the other foot. Extend your arms sideways and hold.
Face the camera and keep your whole movement in view.
en.focus: Checks describe visible shape only. The new checks are experimental.

zh-Hant.name: 單腳平衡
zh-Hant.subtitle: 可見姿勢檢查
steps: 以單腳站立，抬起另一隻腳，雙臂向兩側伸展並保持姿勢。
面向鏡頭，讓整個動作保持在畫面內。
zh-Hant.focus: 檢查只描述可見姿勢。新增檢查仍屬實驗性質。
